units.source_text: 梅壶女御作出深知秋天风趣的样子，回答源氏内大臣说爱好秋景，过后回想，懊悔莫及，深觉可耻。

en.t: The Umetsubo Consort, pretending to understand the charms of autumn deeply, answered the Minister Genji that she loved the autumn scenery; afterward, when she thought back on it, she was overcome with regret and felt deeply ashamed.
In her dejection, it finally turned into real distress.

units.source_text: 但源氏内大臣斩断了这一缕情丝，比以前更加亲切地照拂她了。

en.t: But the Minister Genji cut off that slender thread of feeling, and cared for her even more kindly than before.

units.source_text: 他走进内室，对紫姬说道：“

en.t: He went into the inner room and said to Lady Murasaki, "

units.source_text: 梅壶女御爱好秋夜，亦甚可喜；而你喜欢春晨，更是有理。

en.t: It is very pleasing that the Umetsubo Consort loves autumn nights; but it is even more fitting that you love spring mornings.

units.source_text: 今后赏玩四时花草之时，亦当按照你的欢心而安排。

en.t: From now on, when we enjoy the flowers and grasses of the four seasons, I shall arrange things according to what delights you.

units.source_text: 我身为公私事务所羁绊，不能任情游乐。

en.t: I am bound by affairs both public and private, and cannot amuse myself as freely as I wish.

units.source_text: 常想依照夙愿，遁入禅门。

en.t: I often think of fulfilling my long-held wish and withdrawing into the Buddhist path.

units.source_text: 但不忍教你独守孤寂，不免怅惘耳。”

en.t: But I cannot bear to leave you alone in loneliness, and that is why I cannot help feeling sorrowful."
